title: IP63902: Clinical Legal Program (Teaching
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

CLINICAL LEGAL PROGRAMS (LAB)1.Advanced Legal WritingIntroduce to various
writing styles, practice the major principles of legal writing, and prepare
drafts of briefs, memoranda, contracts, arguments- writing case comments and
reviews, formulate topics, conceptualize proposals, and structure the research
and writing, developing research papers and articles.2.Teaching Learning
Assistance Program Acquaint the student to teaching methods, prepare class
notes- teaching material- assignment for discussion on topics;
